d1e10.d: The Concordance Plot tool provides a visualization of Concordance search results within AntConc.

d1e17.t: Viewing Search Terms in the Corpus
d1e17.d: You can use the Concordance Plot tool view individual search terms within a map of search terms.

d1e24.t: Mapping and Viewing Search Terms in the Corpus
d1e24.d: You can use the Concordance Plot tool to map and view search terms within a corpus.

d1e31.d: You can rearrange your search results using KWIC sort option in Concordance tool.

d1e39.d: File View displays the contents of text files in text form. Other tools within AntConc often use File View to display results.

d1e46.d: KWIC Lines show target words and their context.

d1e53.t: Mapping Search Terms in the Corpus
d1e53.d: You can use the Concordance Plot tool to display a visual representation of the a term's hits within a corpus.
